object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Acknowledge a link, then make one commit that revises the target and also changes the link's acknowledged commit; acknowledge the link and commit again. Expected: after the first commit the link is suspect, with that commit as the target's last change; after acknowledging it reads OK, and the second commit, which changed only the links file, isn't the target's last change.
